mentions.name: Nuts.services
mentions.description: Suite of unbundled services for agentic control that can run locally in a container, on Cloud Run, or via the author's hosted cloud (email-only login, self-hostable, eventually paid). Provides pure random numbers from an SDR radio at the author's house relayed to Cloud Run, the Grubcrawler agentic crawler, embeddings with vector inversion (Shivvr, newer embeddings coming), a Cloud Run based tunneling system, a Lightning Network interconnect (Charon.nuts.services), and Sailfish, a WIP to run optimized Gemma4 models with a drafter on 16GB GPUs, plus cloud training on n8's tool call extraction layer.
mentions.source_excerpt: Nuts.services (url there) -> unbundled services for agentic control. Supports running locally in a container, or on Cloud run, or just use what I have up there in the cloud.
